steps.title: Analyze and Inspect Build Error
steps.description: Examine the error log to pinpoint the invalid 'match_size' attribute value inside the primary UI layout file.

steps.title: Fix Layout Attributes in activity_main.xml
steps.description: Correct the 'match_size' attribute typo to 'match_parent' in the main layout configuration to comply with standard Android resource specifications.

steps.title: Verify Color Configurations
steps.description: Ensure colors.xml is fully loaded and provides appropriate dark brushed metal base values and retro cyan LCD backlight accents.

steps.title: Validate Skeuomorphic Button Drawables
steps.description: Verify layered 3D physical keys represent expected offsets, bevel colors, and compressed pressed states.

steps.title: Confirm Android Manifest Integrity
steps.description: Inspect launch permissions and confirm relative reference activities point to verified custom packages.

steps.title: Evaluate Expression Processing Code
steps.description: Double-check mathematical parsing compiler handles percentage, factorial, parenthetical balancing, and implicit multiplication correctly.

steps.title: Inspect Gradle Scripts compatibility
steps.description: Validate target versions, application namespace bindings, and compilation toolchains in build.gradle.

steps.title: Validate SharedPreferences Persistence
steps.description: Check that the UI properly loads mathematical formulas, degree/radian flags, and dynamic memory logs across lifecycles.

steps.title: Check Layout Viewports & Weights
steps.description: Verify layout weights properly stretch and compress scientific drawers on portrait screen orientations.

steps.title: Building 3D Calculator Pro
steps.description: Execute the Gradle assembleDebug task with fixed skeuomorphic layouts and clean build parameters.
